ask

pages · 1.0.2 · aj-p-ask

Ask (v4 C2): a chatbot over the person's own entries. The masthead with the open day's date box, then the chat: the head row (the History and Bookmarks pills, New or Today), the day's sessions as bubbles, the composer at its foot. Search left Ask for the Timeline (C1).

variantplatformmobile · tablet · desktop (default mobile)
variantstatetoday · past · history · bookmarks · drawers · rate · writing · empty · cant · failed · loading (default today)
variantcontextscreen · walkthrough (default screen)
contentdatadata
statedefaultyes: today
statehovern/a: a page; its controls carry their own
statefocus-visiblen/a: a page; its controls carry their own
stateactiven/a: a page; its controls carry their own
statedisabledn/a: a page; a past day is read only (past)
stateselectedn/a: a page; the drawers mark the open day
stateloadingyes: loading (Ask opening) and writing (an answer arriving)
stateerroryes: cant (not in the journal) and failed (not sent)
stateemptyyes: empty (a new session, nothing asked)

Bookmarks

Today, Sunday 9 August

Session 1 · 08:10

What do I write about when I can’t sleep?

Sleep comes up in eleven of your entries since June. Nine of them were written after ten at night (6 Aug), and most are less about the night than about the next day: work you haven’t started, a call you keep putting off.

The nights you slept well, you had been out walking first (3 Jul).

2 entries used
  • Slept badly again. I’ve stopped counting which night this is.Thursday 6 August, 22:10
  • Walked to the canal after work. The swans were exactly where they always are, which I found more reassuring than it probably is.Friday 3 July, 18:20

Was July any better?

A little. You wrote about sleep four times in July and said twice that you slept well (3 Jul). Both times you had been outside in the evening.

1 entry used
  • Walked to the canal after work. The swans were exactly where they always are, which I found more reassuring than it probably is.Friday 3 July, 18:20

Session 2 · 21:40, open

When did I last feel properly calm?

Sunday the 2nd. You walked the canal as far as the second bridge and wrote that you didn’t listen to anything (2 Aug).

Before that, the last time you used the word calm was 14 June, on another walk past the water (14 Jun).

2 entries used
  • Walked the canal as far as the second bridge and back. Didn’t listen to anything.Sunday 2 August, 17:05
  • Took the long way round past the water. Two swans and a heron that left before I got close.Sunday 14 June, 11:30

What have I said about the office lately?
